title: From the Slaughter Outside to the Assault on Banda Singh’s Fort

blocks.text: This page first closes the slaughter outside the fort by stressing that every Singh killed one or two enemy soldiers before falling. Those who had come out under false assurances did not return with news, and the losses convinced the Mughals that the fort itself might now be taken.

The narrative then turns openly into a new assault phase as officers resolve to attack and capture Banda Singh's fort before the defenders recover. Ladders, guns, and cannon were positioned around the enclosure, and the besiegers spoke as if a reduced Sikh garrison could now be finished by methodical pressure.

The page therefore works as a hinge between one massacre and another operation. It ends the deception outside the walls and opens the formal Mughal storming attempt against Banda Singh's remaining stronghold.
